content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (INSURANCE), fallback target.**

- **Only responsive clause:** § 14.6 (p0603). Searches for E&O, cyber, workers' compensation, general liability, certificates, and personal-data processing returned no other insurance or data-handling coverage anywhere in the agreement.
- **Why it fails fallback:** 14.6 requires only insurance "consistent with normal business practices," naming product liability, with no monetary limits and no E&O or cyber/privacy coverage. The fallback floors (E&O USD 1M; cyber USD 2M) are unmet.
- **Cure:** a single inserted sentence (new 14.7) imposing the two missing minimum limits on RevMed only — Sanofi's self-insurance right, the evidence-on-request mechanic, the cancellation-notice obligation and the no-limit-on-indemnity savings language are all preserved verbatim. No workers' comp, certificate, or CGL terms were volunteered, since those sit only at the preferred level.
